'''[[Odionate]] planetary [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]]''' were used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s military forces during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. These gunships were used as troop transports during planetary invasions such as the [[Invasion of Sarrassia|invasion]] of [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]]. They were subsequently used to ferry [[Grumani Hierophant]]s who had been enslaved by Odion's forces back to Odionate territory. Notably, they bore a significant superficial resemblance to the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] gunships used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a millennium after Odion's time.
